'''Pyke Syndicate's Armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="Reveal" /> used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> sometimes worn by non-[[Pyke/Legends|Pykes]].<ref name="Reveal" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Pyke-Syndicates-Armor-Concept.jpg|right|250px|thumb|Pyke Syndicate's Armor asset by Isaac Kellis.]]
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[December 13]], [[2022]], as part of a tie-in promotion for the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett|''The Book of Boba Fett'']],<ref name="Reveal" /> being directly inspired by the [[Pyke Syndicate]] soldiers who served as antagonists in the show.<ref name="TBOBF">''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''</ref> The set was modeled by character artist [[Isaac Kellis]].<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=isaackellis|url=artwork/EvbyV2|name=[[Isaac Kellis]]|text=Star Wars: The Old Republic - Pyke Syndicate outfit|date=2023-05-25|quote=Created for Star Wars: The Old Republic Star Wars © & TM 2023 Lucasfilm Ltd. All rights reserved}}</ref>
